column7: Counts an HTTP request for U1 and reports the window seal; a mistake would serve a request after the seal uncounted, or refuse one before it (MIK-7211)
Builds the 503 for a request refused after the U1 seal, with the request's own id; a wrong id leaves the client waiting (MIK-7211)
Takes the HTTP counts and, when sealing, sets the seal in the same registry critical section; a mistake would let a served request escape the sealed counts (MIK-7211)
Opens the segment before serving, checkpoints it, seals on the broadcast and bounds the final write; off records and seals nothing (MIK-7211)
